Do not blanket-clone candidate-containing visual meshes: inspect additionalSourceCount and containsText first.
Native cuboid recommendations are exact raw source bounds; rounded visual bevels are intentionally omitted from the simple collision proxy.
Waterfall stairs rise up to45studs; the existing3landings cannot replace84missing stair pieces.
